about: The Workbench icons of the BoboBot drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is BoboBot's own icon (bobobot-icon.xpm, made a PNG). BoboBot-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, BoboBot.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet bobobot.info on a disk that ignores case. The images, sounds, levels, mods and docs drawers inside have drawer icons of their own.
